answer: Make each identity prove where it physically runs. Verifier agents scattered worldwide ping it at random; light in fiber covers about 200 km per millisecond, and a server can add delay but never remove it, so round-trip times pin it to a region. Identities whose latency maps differ by a delta under 2 ms count as one site and split one reward. A 1,000-fake farm on a single terrace of racks earns like one agent; to pass as 1,000 it must rent machines in 1,000 distinct places, a canyon of cost.
